svg.aria-label: Stacked horizontal bar of one mean decode token, 229.5 ms, in profiling run a78bca with gamingrig's GPUs at idle clocks. Device turns: Z13 44.0 ms; the rig, 14 turns over 11 cards, 45.1 ms; gamingrig, 4 turns on 2 cards, 72.3 ms; A6000 compute and sampling 9.2 ms. Then network 34.8 ms, 15 percent of the token; the RPC servers' extra replies, such as the read after each failed CUDA-to-Vulkan copy, 17.4 ms, 12.3 ms of it on the rig; and GPURIG's client time 6.7 ms. RPC command handling inside the device turns is at most 45.5 ms. Below, a second bar with no breakdown: the plain token in run 883b7a, gamingrig at high clocks, 166.5 ms.
